mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(execution_time), 0) FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) END as accuracy_rate FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN prev_accuracy IS NULL OR prev_accuracy = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_accuracy - prev_accuracy), 2) END as accuracy_lift FROM ( SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100.0 WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 0 END) as curr_accuracy, AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AND status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100.0 WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN 0 END) as prev_accuracy FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) t

SELECT CASE WHEN prev_time IS NULL OR prev_time = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((prev_time - curr_time) / prev_time) * 100, 2) END as time_saved_rate FROM ( SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN execution_time END) as curr_time, AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN execution_time END) as prev_time FROM prediction_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) t
